items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Old Louis would play 'Cornet Chop Suey,' and then 'The Heebie-Jeebies' when he'd get... Old Louis...it was special when we'd play a dance

ctx.x: Barney never spoke about that. Neither did anybody else I've interviewed, Trummy or anybody else. I didn't know you played dances. I thought you just played concerts.

No, sir. Well, that was when we had fun, because we played such a variety of tunes. That's when old Louis would play "Cornet Chop Suey," and then "The Heebie-Jeebies" when he'd get... Old Louis...it was special when we'd play a dance and he had been hittin' that Courvoisier brandy a little -- and he'd start wailing. Then he'd half lit up, and we...
